title: crossentropy
summary: Compute cross-entropy loss for numeric predictions and targets.
description: `crossentropy(Y,T)` computes mean cross-entropy over same-sized numeric prediction and target arrays.
behaviors: Inputs must be finite, non-empty numeric arrays with the same number of elements.
Predictions are clipped to a small open interval before taking logs.
Optional format/reduction arguments are rejected with explicit compatibility errors.
Advanced options, dlarray label-aware reductions, and weighting remain future work.
gpu_residency: `crossentropy` runs on host tensors in this slice; provider kernels remain future GPU work.
